SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Headquarters, S. S.    Station
Date 20 / 2 / 33
Date February 18, 1933
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. No. D 4485）

Subject (in full) Report on Syngman Rhee

Made by D.S. Kim    Forwarded by C.D.I. [签名]

I have made inquiries amongst Korean residents
and I am informed that Dr. Rhee was elected President of
the Korean Provisional Government in 1919 by the Senate
which was formed by Korean revolutionists in the French
Concession early in 1919. At that time Dr. Rhee was in
America. He came to Shanghai in the Spring of 1920 at
the request of the Senate and stayed in Shanghai till the
Autumn of 1921. Later he left for America to further
the Korean independence movement.

After his departure the presidential post was occupied
by many persons and the constitution of the Korean
Provisional Government was changed from the presidential
to the committee system.

H. S. Kim
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch
[签名]
20.2.33.

日期 33年2月20日
日期 1933年2月18日
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别分部登记处。编号 D 4485）

事由（全称） 关于李承晚的报告

由 D.S. Kim 制作    由 C.D.I. [签名] 转呈

我已在朝鲜居民中进行查询，
据告知，李承晚博士于1919年由参议院选举为
大韩民国临时政府总统，该参议院由朝鲜革命者
于1919年初在法租界组建。当时李承晚博士身在
美国。他应参议院请求于1920年春季来到上海，
并在上海停留至1921年秋季。随后他前往美国，以
推动朝鲜独立运动。

在他离任后，总统职位由多人担任，且大韩民国
临时政府的宪制由总统制改为委员会制。

H. S. Kim
D. S.

特别分部主管警官
[签名]
33.2.20.

THE PEKING LEADER Friday, January 6, 1922.

Dr. Syngman Rhee

Underwood & Underwood

Dr. Rhee, "President of the Re-
public of Korea" is in Washington to
observe the portion of the Conference
pertaining to Far Eastern affairs with
a view to obtaining, if possible, re-
cognition for his "Republic". Dr.
Rhee is a graduate of Harvard and
Princeton. He was elected "Pre-
sident" of Korea in 1917. Said as
